thread:
Leah (docs): quick FYI — found a broken terraform example in the provisioning guide. it uses isolationMode = "PREEMPT" which 404s on apply (schema changed).
Omar (eng-platform): thanks. which file path?
Leah (docs): /docs/examples/terraform/reserved-pool.tf and the guide at /docs/dedicated/provisioning.md links to it. also two anchors pointing to #preempt-model and #tenant-safety are 404 after the refactor.
Felix (sdk): isolationMode was replaced with eviction_mode_enum in the provider schema last quarter. values are IMMEDIATE | GRACEFUL. the terraform example needs to be changed and we should show the enum usage.
Ruth (prod): customer-facing sample should prefer GRACEFUL for examples. also add a short note about behavior differences.
Leah (docs): agreed. i'll swap the snippet and add a one-line callout: "Use eviction_mode_enum = "GRACEFUL" in examples; map older isolationMode values as shown."
Omar (eng-platform): i'll add static redirects for the anchors to the new #eviction-behavior anchor so external links don't break.
Felix (sdk): suggested terraform snippet replacement:
```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "example" {
  region           = "us-west-2"
  capacity         = 2
  eviction_mode_enum = "GRACEFUL"
}
```
Leah (docs): perfect — please also add a two-line compatibility mapping under the snippet: isolationMode: PREEMPT -> eviction_mode_enum: IMMEDIATE; isolationMode: SOFT -> GRACEFUL.
Ruth (prod): one doc wording ask: the paragraph currently says "Reserved pools prevent eviction" — change to "Reserved pools reduce eviction likelihood but do not guarantee immunity under cluster emergencies."
Leah (docs): will change the sentence and link to SLO fallback table.
bot-cicd: preview site created: https://deploy-preview.redwood-docs.net/560 (shows updated terraform snippet). validator note: docs/examples/terraform/reserved-pool.tf line 14: unknown field isolationMode.
Felix (sdk): pushed commit to docs branch replacing the field and adding mapping.
Omar (eng-platform): added redirect files for the two anchors, verified they return 301.
Leah (docs): merged after quick approvals and copyedit. published. leaving a follow-up ticket for a tenant-eviction diagram per Ruth's request: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/DTX-1199. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
